origin.description: Displays a plot of iterations vs. sampled values for each variable in the chain, with a separate plot per variable.
origin.usage: traceplot(x, smooth = FALSE, col = 1:6, type = "l", xlab = "Iterations", ylab = "", ...)

arguments.name: smooth
arguments.text: Draw a smooth line through the trace plot.

arguments.name: col
arguments.text: Graphical parameter (see par). Recycled across chains.

origin.details: The chain is wrapped as an mcmc.list. Each variable is drawn with matplot, one column per chain, against the iteration index from time. When variable names exist and main was not passed, the panel title is Trace of that name. smooth draws stats::lowess through each chain.
origin.value: The plot is drawn. The function returns NULL.
origin.example: n <- 2000; i <- seq_len(n); x <- cbind(sin(i/3)+0.2*cos(i), cos(i/5)+0.01*i, rep(2, n)); colnames(x) <- c("alpha", "beta", "gamma"); y <- cbind(sin(i/4)+0.15*cos(i/2), cos(i/6)+0.005*i, rep(1, n)); colnames(y) <- colnames(x); traceplot(mcmc.list(mcmc(x, start=11, thin=2), mcmc(y, start=11, thin=2)))

translation.description: Displays a plot of iterations vs. sampled values for each variable in the chain, with a separate panel per variable.
translation.usage: traceplot(x, smooth=False, col=None, type="l", xlab="Iterations", ylab="", **kwargs)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An Mcmc chain or an McmcList.

arguments.name: smooth
arguments.text: Draw a lowess line through each chain.

arguments.name: col
arguments.text: Color or palette index, recycled across chains. The default is palette positions 1 through 6.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Plot type: l, p, b, o, h, s, S, or n.

arguments.name: main
arguments.text: Passed in kwargs. When omitted and variable names exist, each panel is titled Trace of that name.

translation.details: The chain is wrapped as an McmcList. Each variable is one Matplotlib panel, one line per chain, against the iteration index. When variable names exist and main was not passed, the panel title is Trace of that name. smooth draws Cleveland's lowess through each chain, matching stats::lowess.
translation.value: A dict with panels (coordinates, titles, and any smooth curves) and the Matplotlib figure.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from coda.as_mcmc import as_mcmc
from coda.mcmc_list import mcmc_list
from coda.traceplot import traceplot
n = 2000
i = np.arange(1, n + 1, dtype=float)
x = np.column_stack((np.sin(i / 3) + 0.2 * np.cos(i), np.cos(i / 5) + 0.01 * i, np.full(n, 2.0)))
y = np.column_stack((np.sin(i / 4) + 0.15 * np.cos(i / 2), np.cos(i / 6) + 0.005 * i, np.full(n, 1.0)))
first = as_mcmc(x, start=11, thin=2)
second = as_mcmc(y, start=11, thin=2)
first.colnames = second.colnames = ["alpha", "beta", "gamma"]
traceplot(mcmc_list(first, second))
